title: Thrill Combo 1.3
description_html:
Combo Activity :

(Free Style Bungee + Any one From Reverse Bungee/ Gaint Swing / Scad Jump) 

Combo Activity Includes:

  • Free Style Bungee (160 ft)
  • Reverse Bungee in Rishikesh (180 ft) 

Freestyle Bungee Jumping at Thrill Factory is not just a fall. It is a full-blown flight of freedom. With a 160 ft jump height and a full-body harness, this experience gives you the ability to flip, dive, or freefall in your own unique style. Unlike traditional bungee jumping, freestyle allows greater mobility in mid-air, turning your adrenaline rush into a personal performance.

Whether you're a first-timer looking to conquer your fears or a seasoned jumper chasing your next thrill, our freestyle bungee offers the perfect mix of safety, intensity and fun. Every second of the drop is heart-racing and unforgettable.

 

Experience the Thrill of Reverse Bungee Jumping in Rishikesh Reverse bungee jumping in Rishikesh offers a heart-racing adventure that will leave you exhilarated and craving for more. At Thrill Factory, you'll have the opportunity to engage in this unique and thrilling activity that takes bungee jumping to new heights. Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-fueled experience as you are catapulted into the sky with incredible force. The anticipation builds as you reach the pinnacle of the jump, and then the sudden release sends you soaring through the air, defying gravity. Reverse bungee jumping provides an extraordinary sensation of weightlessness and an unparalleled rush of excitement.
